items.t: Leaking capacitors in the engine computer
items.note: Repair services that recap the board cost much less than a new computer.

items.t: Gauges stick or warning lights fail in the cluster
Power steering pump or rack leak
items.job: Replace power steering rack or pump and hoses
items.note: An owner reported a $1,300 dealer quote vs about $420 for a remanufactured part.

items.t: Front suspension creaks and clunks
items.job: Replace strut rods, bushings or struts

items.t: Starter clicks but engine will not crank
items.note: The starter is buried under the intake on many cars.

items.t: Air suspension leaks and the car sags
items.job: Replace air strut(s) or height sensor, or convert to coil springs
items.note: An owner reported about $1,300 for a full conversion to conventional shocks and springs.

items.t: Worn front control arm bushings on the LS 430
Rough shifting at low speeds
items.job: Transmission software update and fluid service

items.t: Door lock actuator fails
items.note: Owners report about $700 at a dealer.

items.t: Radiator leaks at the top seam
Exhaust Y-pipe cracks or gasket leaks
Rear A/C line leak
items.job: Replace rear A/C line, evacuate and recharge
items.note: An owner reported about $1,500 total at a dealer.

items.t: Mark Levinson stereo loses sound or volume jumps
Front control arm bushings crack on the LS 460
items.job: Replace front upper and lower control arms
items.note: Owners report dealer quotes of $3,000-$6,500 for all front arms vs about $700 with aftermarket parts.

items.t: Brake actuator failure turns on warning lights
items.note: Ask a dealer whether the extended warranty covers your VIN.
